title: Houdini AI Assistant: From Image References to an Animated 3D Mecha
author: RaduCius
selftext:
I’m Radu, the developer of Houdini AI Assistant. For this demo, I supplied image references, prompts, and feedback to guide the creation of an editable 3D mecha scene inside Houdini.

The assistant worked on:

* Building and refining the mecha, with procedural controls for body proportions, limbs, and weapon scale.
* Creating materials and surface wear using visual references.
* Building a character rig with Houdini’s APEX system and setting up walk, attack, and pursuit animations.
* Creating the industrial hangar and lighting for the final renders.

I directed the iterations and made adjustments throughout. The assistant continued working in the same scene, refining the result while preserving earlier work.

The video shows the finished scene, editable controls, and earlier stages of the build. Created with Houdini AI Assistant v0.3.0.

Which part would you like to see in a detailed breakdown: modeling, materials, rigging, or animation?
